purpose: Machine-readable index of systems, information, graph, logic, provenance and maintenance ideas being tested against the existing House / Atlas architecture.
governing_rule: Promote a formalism only when it solves a repeated concrete problem, fits an existing owner or contract, survives cross-domain counterexamples and can be tested or validated without creating a competing architecture.

components.T_N: selected rooted North arborescence used for canonical orientation

formal_house_model.research_interpretation: One North is compatible with many legitimate contexts when canonical North is an orientation arborescence embedded in richer typed graphs.

candidate_principles.expression: Match complexity in the backend; compress complexity at the interface.
candidate_principles.use: Schemas, relation types, epistemic states and room grammars must be expressive enough for corpus diversity without exposing all complexity at once.

candidate_principles.expression: Every View is a lossy channel; declare what it is allowed to lose.
candidate_principles.use: Projection contracts should record material omissions, aggregation and source path back.

candidate_principles.expression: Good architecture compresses repetition without compressing distinctions.
candidate_principles.use: Guide consolidation and Room fission using an MDL-like complexity tradeoff.

candidate_principles.expression: One North can be a selected arborescence inside a richer reality.
candidate_principles.use: Keep one stable canonical parent while preserving other broader contexts as Roads/Views.

candidate_principles.expression: Centrality is always centrality under a graph definition.
candidate_principles.use: Prevent graph metrics from silently becoming truth, authority, causality or universal importance.

candidate_principles.expression: Composition should happen at interfaces, not by erasing boundaries.
candidate_principles.use: Keep modules/Rooms differentiated while validating their shared interfaces.

candidate_principles.expression: A healthy system requires enough sensors to observe the failures it claims to regulate.
candidate_principles.use: Validators and health audits should cover the failure modes named in governance rules.

candidate_principles.expression: Make impossible states difficult to represent.
candidate_principles.use: Relation/schema contracts should prevent category errors before presentation.

candidate_principles.expression: When it happened, when we learned it, and when we interpreted it are different times.
candidate_principles.use: Separate validity, recording and interpretation time for recovered/developing material.

candidate_principles.expression: Know not only where a claim came from, but what process turned it into the current representation.
candidate_principles.use: Track transformations, activities and agents for major syntheses/derived outputs.

candidate_principles.expression: Dependency knowledge should power both provenance and incremental builds.
candidate_principles.use: Use lineage for impact analysis, stale detection and selective rebuild/review.

candidate_principles.expression: Mountain and Tree are inverse navigation directions, not necessarily inverse functions.
candidate_principles.use: Coarse-graining is lossy even if navigation can return to source ingredients.

candidate_principles.expression: Experiment in reversible Views; mutate canonical identity conservatively.
candidate_principles.use: Keep costly merges/reparents/deletes behind stronger review than projection experiments.

candidate_principles.expression: Swamp is a diagnostic vector; Garden is a viability region.
candidate_principles.use: Avoid moral or universal scalar scores; retain multiple failure/health dimensions.

candidate_principles.expression: Retrieval failure is a system state, not automatically a claim about reality.
candidate_principles.use: Differentiate absent, unindexed, alias-hidden, source-only, unresearched and unavailable.

candidate_principles.expression: The system learns only if contradiction can change the model.
candidate_principles.use: Provide review routes from contradiction/question back into canonical revision or durable unresolved state.

candidate_principles.expression: Health metrics should diagnose, not become isolated targets.
candidate_principles.use: Reduce Goodhart pressure from node counts, relation counts, coverage or confidence scores.

candidate_principles.expression: Expansion without gardening becomes Swamp; gardening without expansion becomes a museum.
candidate_principles.use: Alternate exploration with consolidation, validation and pruning.

advanced_candidates.gate: defined non-geographic graph and concrete layout/diagnostic need
deep hierarchy whose Euclidean navigation is demonstrably poor
directed edges with compatible quantities, units, period and source coverage
real threshold-sensitivity question on sufficiently large empirical graph
ordinary cross-view consistency validators become insufficient
actual object-attribute data and a neighborhood-discovery task
typed subsystem interfaces need formal composition beyond ordinary schemas

red_team: Do not use mathematics merely because vocabulary resembles project symbolism.
Do not infer truth, authority, morality or causality from centrality, clustering or visual proximity.
Do not use entropy without a defined probability/coding model.
Do not use control theory without declared states, observations, controls and constraints.
Do not treat Mountain compression as lossless.
Do not add advanced formalism where a simple schema, validator or typed relation solves the problem.
Do not promote research notes into canonical architecture without a repeated concrete need.
